entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Noël Milarew Odingar was a Chadian military officer who served as head of state for two days after the 1975 coup d'état. He was subsequently one of the nine members of the Supreme Military Council, the military junta that ruled Chad between 1975 and 1978.

entities.summary: Noël Milarew Odingar was a Chadian military officer who served as head of state for two days after the 1975 coup d'état. He was subsequently one of the nine members of the Supreme Military Council, the military junta that ruled Chad between 1975 and 1978.
